The most serious crime he can be convicted of is **C. Involuntary manslaughter**. Transferred intent carries his intent to commit a battery over to the victim, but intent to inflict only a slight wound does not supply the malice murder requires, and he lacked the intent to kill or seriously harm that voluntary manslaughter requires. The death resulted from an unlawful act (shooting a gun at another person), which supports unlawful-act involuntary manslaughter.

CONFIDENCE: 65
